decisions.reason: The submarine lighting is far from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, so its results are uncertain, but the expanding firm has the slack to carry a niche maritime product that fits its maritime customer base.

The medical examination light builds on established competences and has its own product page, and in a growing industry with an expanding firm there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires are a natural extension of the firm's certified industrial lighting and likely meet aspirations, so the firm has no reason to drop them.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the core offer, so its results likely meet the aspiration level built on its past success.
